description: Synthetic 150 s team-meeting transcript with one known category per segment. Labels are used only to score model output and are never sent to the model.

segments.label: filler
segments.text: Okay, um, can everyone hear me? Let me just share my screen. Give me one second.

segments.label: admin
segments.text: Good morning. Agenda today: budget update, the caching project, and then open questions.

segments.label: admin
segments.text: The budget for this quarter is unchanged. Finance has approved the same numbers as last quarter.

segments.label: educational
segments.text: So, quick explanation of why the app got faster. A cache keeps a copy of data we already fetched, so the next request skips the database. Reads went from two hundred milliseconds to five.

segments.label: joke
segments.text: Our intern tried to fix the printer by apologising to it. It worked better than our last three IT tickets, so we are now promoting the printer to team lead.

segments.label: announcement
segments.text: Reminder: the office closes early on Friday, and the kitchen will be cleaned on Thursday.

segments.label: filler
segments.text: Uh, sorry, where was I. Yeah. Let me find the next slide. Okay.

segments.label: educational
segments.text: The catch with caching is invalidation. If the data changes and the cache does not, users see stale results. We fixed that by expiring entries after sixty seconds and clearing them on every write.

segments.label: admin
segments.text: Please submit your timesheets by Monday. The template is in the shared folder.

segments.label: qa
segments.text: Question from Priya: does the cache work for logged-out users too, or only for people who are signed in?

segments.label: qa
segments.text: Good question. Yes, logged-out pages are cached even more aggressively, because they are the same for everyone.

segments.label: joke
segments.text: Why did the developer go broke? Because he used up all his cache. Thank you, I will be here all week, please tip your server.

segments.label: announcement
segments.text: Also, the parking garage on level two is closed for repairs starting next week.

segments.label: filler
segments.text: Mm-hm. Right. Okay, okay. Let me check the chat. Nothing there.

segments.label: conclusion
segments.text: So here is the decision: we roll the cache out to all customers next Tuesday. That cuts our server costs by about forty percent, which is the single biggest saving we have made this year.

segments.label: admin
segments.text: The next meeting is the same time next week. I will send the calendar invite after this call.

segments.label: filler
segments.text: Okay, that is everything. Thanks everyone, bye. Bye bye. See you.
